summary: Tested the world recruit-city feature end to end. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass. Checked: 1,725 cities seeded across 244 countries; /recruit/world totals; /recruit/cities filters (country, continent, q, limit), sorted by population, all 1,725 rows returned in 0.15s; city detail page_lang/currency/nearby for tokyo-jp, lagos-ng, sao-paulo-br, paris-fr and los-angeles-ca; 404 for unknown city; admin stats filters plus auth guard; sitemap join URLs; register with recruit_city_slug=tokyo-jp sets recruit_country=JP. Frontend: /join index stats, search and continent tabs work, and country tiles link to the right pages. /join/continent/europe shows only Europe. /join/country/fr, /jp and /us list their cities. Tokyo auto-translates to Japanese (html lang=ja, ¥15,800). The English toggle works, persists in localStorage and survives a reload, and leaving the page restores lang=en. Paris shows French and €89, São Paulo shows pt-BR and R$509. LA has no toggle and shows $100. A logged-in provider sees a share bar with /join/lagos-ng?ref=CODE. All CTAs are present: persona-join-world, footer-link-join-world, become-provider-find-city, country-work-cta on /in/japan, recruiter-world-link. Admin Recruit tab filters work, and non-US rows show the country name. No page errors.

minor.issue: Admin total is 1726 but the public total is 1725. The extra row is a leftover inactive test city 'test-city-1789909634' from an earlier test run; it should be removed.
Default limit=2000 returns about 515KB. It is fast, but the frontend never needs the full list, so a smaller default (e.g. 200) would be safer.

ui_bugs.issue: Los Angeles subhead says '300 spots. $500 sign-on for the first 100.' while the actual bonus is $100. The old seeded US copy contradicts the $100 bonus.

The text puts a literal '$' in front of the already-formatted bonus, giving '$$100' or '$¥15,800'. On the LA page the meta description is the generic site one, so Helmet's description seems to be overridden as well.

issues: formatPrice uses the default currencyDisplay, so the bonus shows as 'NGN 133,235' instead of '₦133,235'. Consider currencyDisplay:'narrowSymbol'.
Roughly 250px empty gap between the continent tabs and the first continent section, caused by the empty AdSense slot (adsense-join-index).
Shows a '?' flag and 'Earn with Lumo in ZZ' instead of a not-found state.
'Total signups', 'Goal' and 'This week' only add up the 300 loaded rows, while 'Cities' shows the full total. Mixed meanings.
Has no country/currency/lang fields and requires a 2-letter State, so admins can only create US cities manually.

action_items: Fix the stale '$500 sign-on' hero_subhead copy on US seeded cities (it should match bonus_amount, $100).
Fix the '$${bonus}' double currency symbol in CityRecruit.jsx localSeoBlurb.
Optional: use the narrowSymbol currency display, delete the leftover test-city-1789909634, add a not-found state for unknown country codes, and add country fields to the admin Add city dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: recruit_cities.py is 701 lines, just over the 700-line split threshold.
seed_world_cities runs update_one on every startup for 94 US rows that have no population and are in the world file. This is harmless but repeats work.
First-time LLM translation of a city page takes about 5-15s; until then the page shows English (São Paulo stayed English for the first 10s, and later loads were translated).
seed_data_creation: Created one provider test_iter67_*@example.com with recruit_city_slug=tokyo-jp during pytest, then deleted it from the DB. Re-running the test creates the user again.
context_for_next_testing_agent: World recruit-city feature verified. The test file test_iter67_world_recruit.py covers the APIs; register needs avatar_url for the provider role. Do not call /api/admin/recruit/broadcast-now. /in/{country} uses the country name slug (/in/japan), not the ISO code.
